strings.FML_peaceful_island_sea_war_desc:
Continental Portugal is in flames, torn between different warring factions vying for power. Cities like Lisbon are to be embroiled in brutal urban warfare, fields in the countryside will be trampled underfoot, and countless lives will be lost.

The archipelagos, by contrast, remain firmly neutral under the control of the Atlantic Naval Command. The peaceful islands of the archipelagos offer a friendly port amidst a brutal storm, and so many of the foreign businesses in Portugal have made the decision to relocate. Even if it's only temporary, the new arrivals have brought a much-needed kick to the islands' economies.
strings.FML_american_boogeyman_desc:
While for now the archipelagos may be a bastion of peace under the Atlantic Naval Command's protection, nobody believes that they alone could truly defend the islands from whoever emerges victorious in continental Portugal. The ANC would have to strike a deal in order to survive, leveraging the value of the archipelagos' military and naval bases.

Fortunately for the ANC, Uncle Sam possessed strategic interests in the region, and the OFN offered to help in defense duties in exchange for access to those bases. The OFN, however, hold little sympathy for the ANC, and are more than willing to offer the archipelagos' on a silver platter to whoever demands them if they are sufficiently cooperative.
strings.FML_american_interests_desc:
The Azores occupies a strategic location within the Atlantic, a position that the OFN would quite like to hold onto. As such, compared to Madeira, the Azores boast a significantly larger OFN presence, and receive a generous helping of aid and economic stimulus.

Certainly the Azores enjoys the wealth this increased presence brings to the islands, but not all that glitters is gold. Washington keeps a careful eye on the islands' government. Any hint that the Azores is attempting to distance itself from the OFN is heavily discouraged, regardless of whether those hints are real or imagined.
strings.FML_little_piece_paradise_desc:
While the Azores have not exactly had a shining past few years, and none wished for Portugal to descend into violent civil war, there is one upside to recent events that has made life a bit easier: the OFN is very wealthy, and more than willing to throw a small portion of that vast wealth at the Azores to keep them safely in OFN hands.

While before the government of the Azores might have been constrained by Iberian debts or overstretched budgets, now they have an abundance of OFN money flowing into their treasury. As such, the government has begun a series of infrastructure and welfare projects in order to improve the lives of the Azorian people. As long as that money keeps flowing, the Azores will prosper.
